description: Audit screen copy, HTML or a public URL for deceptive-design (dark pattern) signals: confirmshaming, forced continuity and hard-to-cancel flows, pre-selected options, false urgency and fake scarcity, misdirection by visual weight, hidden costs, trick questions and double negatives, nagging, forced action or registration, disguised ads, obstruction, and social proof without a source. Give text (one string per line, optional prefixes like button:, link:, checkbox:), and/or html, and/or url. Markup signals include checked inputs, a prominent accept button beside a quiet decline link, countdown timers and cancel flows longer than sign-up flows. Each finding has severity, the evidence string and a fix, and echoes frameworks in general terms (FTC negative option guidance, EU Digital Services Act and Consumer Rights Directive, CPRA). Signals for review, not a legal finding.

html.description: Page or component HTML, to catch checked inputs, timers and control styling

text.description: Screen copy and control labels, one per line, with optional prefixes such as button:, link:, checkbox:, text:. You can describe flows too: 'signup: 2 steps', 'cancel: 6 steps'.

url.description: Public page to fetch and check (static HTML only)
